quotationNarrative: A bespoke 14-day private journey through Vietnam designed for Sara. Experience the timeless charm of Hanoi, the breathtaking karst landscape of Ninh Binh, an exclusive overnight stay on Emeraude Classic Cruise in Ha Long Bay, the misty mountain valleys of Sapa via Chapa Express Train, coastal beauty in Da Nang & Hoi An, and a dynamic grand finale in Ho Chi Minh City.

programOverview.heading: PROGRAM OVERVIEW
paragraphs: This 14-day grand journey is tailored to capture the full cultural and natural essence of Vietnam from North to South.

Featuring handpicked boutique accommodations such as Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa, Emeraude Classic Cruise, Chapa Express Train, Sapa Jade Hill Resort, Radisson RED Danang Hotel, La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa, and Mai House Saigon.

landingpageContent.visualDescription: A luxury travel landing page showcasing iconic landscapes, mountain resorts, cruises, and historic cities of Vietnam.

journeyGlance.domesticFlights: Included as per itinerary (Hanoi - Da Nang & Da Nang - Saigon)
journeyGlance.partnerNote: Early check-in in Hanoi included. Private guide & vehicle throughout.

whyWorks.privateFlexible: Private vehicle and dedicated English-speaking guide allow guests to travel at an unhurried, comfortable pace.
whyWorks.comfort: Rest easy with handpicked boutique hotels, early check-in pre-booked on arrival, and premium sleeper cabins on Chapa Express.
whyWorks.muslimFriendly: Dietary requirements and special meal preferences pre-arranged seamlessly at every destination.
whyWorks.balancedHighlights: A perfect balance of historic cities, serene limestone cruise, mountain scenery in Sapa, heritage towns, and vibrant city culture.

itinerary.summary: Arrival in Hanoi by CX741. Enjoy pre-booked Early Check-in at Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa and rest for half a day. In the evening, gather for a Welcome Dinner followed by an Evening Hanoi Short Walking Tour to ease into the local rhythm.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Airport transfer, Early check-in, Welcome Dinner, Evening Walking Tour.

itinerary.summary: Full Day Ninh Binh Tour from Hanoi. Discover the historic ancient capital of Hoa Lu, the grand Bai Dinh Pagoda, serene sampan boat ride through Trang An landscape, and panoramic views from Mua Cave.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private AC transfer, guide, entrance tickets, Trang An boat tour, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Morning transfer to Ha Long Bay. Embark on the Emeraude Classic Cruise and check into the Captain Suite. Enjoy afternoon cruise activities, kayaking, swimming, and an overnight stay amidst UNESCO karst waters.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private transfer, Emeraude Cruise, Captain Suite, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.summary: Morning cruise activities on Ha Long Bay including Tai Chi and cave visits. Enjoy brunch on board before disembarking and transferring back to Hanoi Le Jardin Hotel & Spa for relaxation.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Morning cruise activity, transfer back to Hanoi, hotel stay.

itinerary.summary: Full Day Hanoi City Tour exploring historic landmarks such as Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, One Pillar Pagoda, Temple of Literature, and the vibrant Old Quarter.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private guide, entrance fees, city tour, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Hat Village & Incense Village Half Day Tour from Hanoi. Free afternoon in Hanoi for leisure and exploration. In the evening, transfer to Hanoi Railway Station to board the overnight Chapa Express Train to Sapa in a Suite Queen Cabin.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Incense & Hat village tour, transfer to Hanoi station, Chapa Express Suite Cabin, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Arrival in Lao Cai/Sapa. Embark on a Full Day Sapa Tour exploring lush rice terraces, local hill-tribe villages, and check in at Sapa Jade Hill Resort (Mountain View Bungalow).
itinerary.mainInclusions: Station pickup, guided Sapa tour, bungalow stay, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.summary: Enjoy a free morning in Sapa. After lunch, transfer to the airport for a domestic flight to Da Nang. Upon arrival, private transfer to Radisson RED Danang Hotel.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Airport transfer, domestic flight, Da Nang pickup & hotel stay, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Full Day Da Nang City Tour highlighting Marble Mountains, Son Tra Peninsula (Linh Ung Pagoda), Dragon Bridge, and local cultural spots.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private guide & vehicle, entrance tickets, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Full Day Hoi An Tour. Transfer to Hoi An Ancient Town, explore lantern-lit streets, Japanese Covered Bridge, and stay at La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa (Deluxe Balcony Queen Classic Wing).
itinerary.mainInclusions: Transfer to Hoi An, guided walking tour, resort check-in, Lunch, Dinner.

itinerary.summary: Morning Hoi An Countryside Cycling Tour through peaceful villages and organic gardens. Free afternoon in Hoi An Ancient Town with custom tailoring recommendations.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Countryside cycling tour, guide, tailoring recommendation, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Transfer to Da Nang Airport and fly to Ho Chi Minh City. In the afternoon, take a guided tour of the historic Cu Chi Tunnels before checking in at Mai House (Premium King Room).
itinerary.mainInclusions: Airport transfers, domestic flight, Cu Chi Tunnels entry & tour, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Full Day Mekong Delta Tour. Cruise down peaceful waterways, visit local artisanal workshops, taste tropical fruits, and experience southern river life.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Private Mekong excursion, boat trip, guide, Lunch.

itinerary.summary: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour exploring Saigon Notre-Dame Basilica, Central Post Office, and War Remnants Museum. Relax before private transfer to the airport for departure flight.
itinerary.mainInclusions: Half day city tour, airport departure transfer, Dinner.

bookingTerms.deposit:
A deposit of 30% of the total tour cost is required upon confirmation of the booking. This deposit is non-refundable.
For bookings confirmed within 60 days of arrival, full payment of 100% of the total tour cost is required at the time of confirmation.
bookingTerms.balance: The remaining 70% balance must be paid no later than 60 days prior to the scheduled arrival date.
bookingTerms.cancellation:
Written notice required. Cancellation fees apply based on arrival date:
• > 45 days prior: Deposit forfeited (30%)
• 45 – 31 days prior: 50% of total tour cost
• 30 – 20 days prior: 75% of total tour cost
• < 20 days prior: 100% of total tour cost
Any non-refundable payments, cancellation charges or penalties imposed by hotels, airlines, cruise operators and other service providers may also apply in addition to the cancellation fees stated above.
bookingTerms.confirmation: The booking will only be considered confirmed once the required payment has been received.

finalization.finalDetailsRequired: Copy of passport valid for at least 6 months and flight details.
finalization.afterConfirmation: 24/7 dedicated local concierge and tour manager support.
